scenes.detail: Luna, age 15, sitting on a stool in the family attic, looking quietly at the inherited black high-top shoe in her hands. Keep her selected face, low dark ponytail, oversized charcoal T-shirt, olive cargo trousers and exact attic beams, brickwork, window, stool and skateboard. Preserve the full-width environmental composition.

Over Luna's shoulder, her bare hands open a cardboard box containing precisely two aged BLACK canvas Converse high-tops, ivory toe caps and soles, off-white laces. A single faded photo of young Rafa with a basketball lies beside the pair. Preserve the intimate top-down framing, cardboard, wood, repaired cream canvas detail. Tiny handwritten R.M. only inside the shoe tongue if readable; no other text.

Rafa at age 16, alone on the 1970 Bronx basketball court at golden hour. Same teen boy face, dark wavy hair, white tank top, navy gym shorts and striped tube socks. BLACK Converse canvas high-tops, ivory soles and toe caps, no repair patch yet. Ball in his right hand at hip. Full body, red-brick tenements, chain-link fence and backboard. Preserve correct anatomy and selected stance.

Rafa at 23, screen left, rust open collar shirt, brown flared trousers and BLACK high-top Converse, reaching toward Elena at 22 on screen right in her violet dress and RED high-top Converse. Keep their exact faces and positions. 1977 dance hall, wooden floor, warm amber and restrained purple lighting. Both complete bodies and shoe silhouettes visible. It is a tender first encounter.

1995. Rafa at 41 sits on the right, light blue rolled-sleeve shirt, dark trousers, brown house shoes, offering one worn BLACK high-top Converse in both hands to his smiling sixteen-year-old daughter seated left in blue denim and white socks. Their exact faces, father-daughter relation, separation and gestures match image 1. Second black shoe on the floor. Warm domestic brick living room, window at left. His daughter will become Luna's mother.

Luna, same 15-year-old face and low dark ponytail, charcoal oversized T-shirt, olive cargo trousers, sitting in the same attic now wearing the inherited black Converse pair, holding grandfather's photo, looking toward the doorway with a soft rediscovered smile. Preserve pose, stool, open shoebox, warm window, wooden beams and brick backdrop. Tender restraint, no crying, no added people.
